response.justification: The candidate is a versatile, experienced senior engineer with strong testing culture, open-source contributions, and some high-throughput systems exposure (low-latency DLang services at Dunnhumby/Sociomantic). However, he falls well short of the core minimum qualification of 8 years of C++ experience (only ~7 months at National Instruments plus a thesis project), his recent work centers on TypeScript/Node.js product engineering rather than cloud compute infrastructure, and he lacks formal technical-leadership experience mentoring cloud/DevOps engineers on large-scale platform strategy.
strengths: Real high-scale, low-latency systems experience (millions of HTTP requests/sec at Dunnhumby/Sociomantic)
Strong software craftsmanship: TDD, CI/CD, testing frameworks, and knowledge-sharing via workshops and talks
Broad full-stack and infrastructure exposure including Kubernetes, Docker, and AWS CDK
concerns: Far below the required 8 years of C++ experience (~7 months professionally; primary systems language is D)
No formal technical-leadership role leading platform strategy or mentoring cloud/DevOps teams
Recent career trajectory is full-stack product development, not large-scale cloud compute platforms
